answers.text: The manual lists reduced or no vacuum as the problem; it does not say this symptom may indicate an unspecified failure mode.
answers.rationale: The excerpt identifies reduced or no vacuum as the problem and gives troubleshooting steps, but does not state that it may indicate an unspecified cause.
The troubleshooting entry identifies the UIT’s blank, unlit screen and instructs the user to make sure the cutting software is open, supporting that software not being open may indicate the problem.

answers.text: The manual lists checking the pen air-cylinder flow control valves, but does not state that the symptom indicates those valves are faulty.
answers.rationale: The manual names possible causes for the broader symptom and separately directs checking the flow-control valves; that check does not establish the valves as a failure mode.
The manual identifies a power-supply problem as a possible cause and separately instructs checking the 24 VDC power-supply fuse, but it does not state that the failure mode affects the fuse.
